reply:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_minor), 0) * 1.0
       / (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
          FROM shop_meta
          WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS refunds_paid_dollars
FROM refunds
WHERE date(created_at) <= (
    SELECT date(value)
    FROM shop_meta
    WHERE key = 'as_of_date'
);

       SUM(oi.unit_price_minor * oi.quantity) /
           (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
            FROM shop_meta
            WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS amount_dollars
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.category;

ORDER BY month;

    c.segment,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) / CAST(
        (SELECT value FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
        AS REAL
    ) AS revenue_dollars
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY c.segment
ORDER BY c.segment;

SELECT
    c.country,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS cancelled_percentage
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY c.country;

WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT p.category, p.id, p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units
    FROM products AS p
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY p.category, p.id, p.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT category, product_name, units,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY units DESC) AS sales_rank
    FROM product_sales
)
SELECT category, product_name, units
FROM ranked
WHERE sales_rank = 1
ORDER BY category, product_name;

WITH order_values AS (
    SELECT o.id,
           COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor), 0) AS merchandise_value
    FROM orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
    GROUP BY o.id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_above_average
FROM order_values
WHERE merchandise_value > (SELECT AVG(merchandise_value) FROM order_values);

SELECT
    o.id AS order_id,
    (COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor), 0) + o.shipping_minor)
        / CAST((SELECT value FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS REAL)
        AS total_dollars
FROM orders AS o
LEFT JOIN order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY o.id, o.shipping_minor
ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor), 0) + o.shipping_minor DESC,
         o.id ASC
LIMIT 3;

       (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
        FROM shop_meta
        WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS total_refunds_dollars

    SELECT date(value)
    FROM shop_meta
    WHERE key = 'as_of_date'
);

    name,
    price_minor * 1.0 / (
        SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
        FROM shop_meta
        WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
    ) AS list_price_dollars
FROM products

LIMIT 5;

FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY c.country;

SELECT
    p.category,
    SUM(oi.unit_price_minor * oi.quantity) /
        (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
         FROM shop_meta
         WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS amount_dollars
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category;

    c.segment,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) * 1.0 /
        (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
         FROM shop_meta
         WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS revenue_dollars
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY c.segment;

    c.country,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
          / COUNT(*), 2) AS cancelled_percentage
FROM customers AS c

GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY c.country;

WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT p.category,
           p.id AS product_id,
           p.name AS product_name,
           SUM(oi.quantity) AS units
    FROM products AS p
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY p.category, p.id, p.name
),
ranked_sales AS (
    SELECT category,
           product_name,
           units,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY units DESC) AS sales_rank
    FROM product_sales
)
SELECT category, product_name, units
FROM ranked_sales
WHERE sales_rank = 1
ORDER BY category, product_name;

WITH order_values AS (
    SELECT o.id,
           COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor), 0) AS merchandise_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    GROUP BY o.id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_above_average
FROM order_values
WHERE merchandise_minor > (SELECT AVG(merchandise_minor) FROM order_values);

SELECT
    o.id AS order_id,
    (COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor), 0) + o.shipping_minor)
        / (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
           FROM shop_meta
           WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS total_dollars
FROM orders AS o
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY o.id, o.shipping_minor
ORDER BY total_dollars DESC, o.id ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
    p.name AS product_name,
    1.0 * p.price_minor / CAST(m.value AS INTEGER) AS list_price_dollars
FROM products AS p
CROSS JOIN shop_meta AS m
WHERE m.key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
ORDER BY p.price_minor DESC, p.name COLLATE NOCASE ASC, p.id ASC
LIMIT 5;

            FROM shop_meta

GROUP BY p.category;

SELECT
    c.segment,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) * 1.0 /
        (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
         FROM shop_meta
         WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS revenue_dollars
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY c.segment;

    c.country AS country_code,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS cancelled_percentage
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY c.country;

    SELECT p.category, p.id, p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units
    FROM products AS p
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY p.category, p.id, p.name
),

    SELECT category, product_name, units,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY units DESC) AS sales_rank
    FROM product_sales
)

FROM ranked
WHERE sales_rank = 1
ORDER BY category, product_name;

    SELECT o.id,
           COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor), 0) AS merchandise_value
    FROM orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id

)

FROM order_values
WHERE merchandise_value > (SELECT AVG(merchandise_value) FROM order_values);

SELECT
    o.id AS order_id,
    (COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor), 0) + o.shipping_minor)
        / (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
           FROM shop_meta
           WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS total_dollars
FROM orders AS o
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY o.id, o.shipping_minor
ORDER BY total_dollars DESC, o.id ASC
LIMIT 3;
